scripts.bootstrap: npm install && node tools/run-python.mjs -m pip install -e ./apps/api[dev]
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:desktop && npm run build:api
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @eidos/shared-types && npm run build --workspace @eidos/shared-ui && npm run build --workspace @eidos/analytics
scripts.lint: npm run lint:ts && npm run lint:py
scripts.lint:py: node tools/run-python.mjs -m ruff check apps/api/app apps/api/tests apps/api/alembic
scripts.format: npm run format:ts && npm run format:py
scripts.format:py: node tools/run-python.mjs -m ruff format apps/api/app apps/api/tests apps/api/alembic
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check:ts && npm run format:check:py
scripts.format:check:py: node tools/run-python.mjs -m ruff format --check apps/api/app apps/api/tests apps/api/alembic
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:ts && npm run typecheck:py
scripts.typecheck:ts: npm run typecheck --workspace @eidos/shared-types && npm run typecheck --workspace @eidos/shared-ui && npm run typecheck --workspace @eidos/analytics && npm run typecheck --workspace @eidos/desktop
scripts.test: npm run test:ts && npm run test:py
